title: The Andong Kwŏn Genealogy of 1476 (安東權氏成化譜): a digital scholarly edition
description: A critical digital edition of the Andong Kwŏn ssi Sŏnghwabo, the oldest extant comprehensive Korean genealogy (1476): node and edge tables of the men it records and the descent and marriage relations among them, the facsimile of the Academy of Korean Studies copy (AKS JE A 55020), and a reading environment presenting each leaf beside the men it records. Tables of 7 July 2025.
